title: Trump announces Israel and Hamas have agreed to the first phase of his Gaza plan
body:
On Wednesday 8 October 2025, US President Donald Trump announced on Truth Social that Israel and Hamas had both signed off on the first phase of his peace plan. Qatar's Foreign Ministry spokesperson Majed al-Ansari said mediators had reached agreement on all the provisions and implementation mechanisms of the first phase and that details would be announced later. The talks were held in Sharm el-Sheikh, Egypt, with Qatar, Turkey, Egypt and the United States as mediators.

According to Al Jazeera, the first phase provided for a ceasefire, an exchange of captives, the entry of aid and an Israeli withdrawal to an agreed line. It covered the release of 48 Israeli captives held in Gaza, including 20 believed to be alive, and of Palestinian prisoners held in Israeli jails. Participants included Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff for the United States, Ron Dermer for Israel, Qatari Prime Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim Al Thani, and Hamas negotiators Khalil al-Hayya and Zaher Jabarin.

Unresolved issues included the timing and extent of Israeli withdrawal, post-war administration of Gaza and the fate of Hamas, with Israel saying the war would end only after Hamas disarmed. The Palestinian Health Ministry said at least eight Palestinians were killed in the previous 24 hours, and health authorities said the war had killed more than 67,000 people. The WHO said 14 of Gaza's 36 hospitals were partially functioning.
